retained_failures: The original adapter rejected the Integer grid with gridUnavailable before implementation.

The licensed launcher initially failed because it had not activated the owned window, then rejected an action arriving before initial focus. Explicit activation and published-focus readiness now precede mutations.
The first renderer assertion compared exact numeric Value type codes; 4D object properties normalize numbers. It now checks original numeric versus text identity and exact key value.
The compiled Text regression read an indexed cell from a table retired during renderer replacement. The read-only wait now reacquires after kAXErrorInvalidUIElement. No mutation is retried.
